BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 43,740 ordinary shares between July 20 and July 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The shares were acquired through Deutsche Bank AG on the London Stock Exchange at a volume-weighted average price of 1,939.78 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 1,995.00 pence and the lowest at 1,893.00 pence. These purchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 113,021,410. This action is part of the second tranche of the buyback program initiated on April 2, 2026. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 27 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 27 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 20 July 2026 up to and including 24 July 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 20 July 2026 10,200 1,958.00 1,903.00 1,934.65 XLON 21 July 2026 10,400 1,930.00 1,898.00 1,914.38 XLON 22 July 2026 3,140 1,917.00 1,893.00 1,902.75 XLON 23 July 2026 10,000 1,995.00 1,937.00 1,959.40 XLON 24 July 2026 10,000 1,985.00 1,944.00 1,963.44 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 3,326,223 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 6,284,539 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 113,021,410 ordinary shares.
